Last Tuesday, Mia and Jack went to the plant garden. Jack's birthday is in February. Mia thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Excuse me, is this seat free?
Both of them like dumplings and milk. Mia learned a lot about English. It takes twenty minutes to get to the plant garden by bike. For example, raindrops danced on the window.
Jack is interested in reading. The plant garden is one of the best places in the city. Mia and Jack had great fun there. In fact, my rabbit eats fresh carrots every day.
Mia borrowed a book about English from the cinema. Mia likes snowy days best. There are always many people at the camping site.
